#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct FastReader {
    std::istringstream ss;
    std::string s;
    std::istream& in;

    FastReader() : in(std::cin) {}
    std::string next() {
        while (!(ss >> s)) {
            std::getline(in, s);
            ss.str(s);
            ss.clear();
        }
        return s;
    }
    int nextInt() { return std::stoi(next()); }
    long long nextLong() { return std::stoll(next()); }
};

static long long dp[1001][25][11];
static int mod = 998244353;

long long go(const std::vector<char>& A, int i, int pv, int v) {
    if (i == (int)A.size()) {
        return pv == 0 ? 1 : 0;
    }
    if (dp[i][pv][v] != -1) return dp[i][pv][v];
    long long ans = 0;
    if (A[i] == '_') {
        for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
            if (i == 0 && j == 0) continue;
            int y = (pv * 10 + j) % 25;
            ans += go(A, i + 1, y, v);
        }
    } else if (A[i] == 'X') {
        if (v != 10) {
            ans += go(A, i + 1, (pv * 10 + v) % 25, v);
        } else {
            for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
                if (i == 0 && j == 0) continue;
                int y = (pv * 10 + j) % 25;
                ans += go(A, i + 1, y, j);
            }
        }
    } else {
        int digit = A[i] - '0';
        ans += go(A, i + 1, (pv * 10 + digit) % 25, v);
    }
    return dp[i][pv][v] = ans;
}

int main() {
    FastReader sc;
    int ttt = 1;
    while (ttt-- > 0) {
        std::string s_str = sc.next();
        std::vector<char> A(s_str.begin(), s_str.end());
        if (A.size() == 1 && A[0] == '0') {
            std::cout << "1\n";
            continue;
        }
        if (A[0] == '0') {
            std::cout << "0\n";
            continue;
        }
        if (A.size() == 1 && (A[0] == 'X' || A[0] == '_')) {
            std::cout << "1\n";
            continue;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= (int)A.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 25; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 11; k++) {
                    dp[i][j][k] = -1;
                }
            }
        }
        std::cout << go(A, 0, 0, 10) << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
